changes.reason: Reject aborted request-body reads before handler dispatch, cancel pending source reads without waiting for cleanup, and remove the abort listener and reader lock on completion. Existing body-size and replay contracts remain.

kubernetes.reason: The shared limiter observes the Fetch Request signal and uses native Web Stream cancellation through the existing Node HTTP transport. Synthetic Node request tests do not verify client-disconnect propagation or a deployed Kubernetes host.
constraints: Requires the host to abort the Request signal; cancellation requests source cleanup but does not await its completion.
No deployed Kubernetes or live disconnect certification.

aws-lambda.reason: The existing Lambda adapter supplies buffered request bodies and does not claim an invocation AbortSignal. The common limiter remains reusable without adding a deadline or Lambda disconnect signal.
constraints: Buffered Lambda input retains the existing size and replay behavior.
No invocation cancellation capability or live AWS certification is added.

cloudflare.reason: The limiter uses portable Fetch and Web Streams operations, but transports-http has no Workers runtime claim and this change supplies no Worker isolate or Node Container execution evidence.
constraints: Portable middleware logic alone does not establish Workers transport support.
No Workers isolate or explicit Node Container deployment is certified.
